name: full-suite-v1
notes: Canonical #13 protocol. Per suite and per (optimizer, seed): 16 genomes x every optimization row x 1 trial of optimizer feedback (identical for both optimizers); validation rows select the suite champion and per-task champions; each frozen suite champion then runs 2 trials on every held-out row of its suite, reporting only. Ajev needs a JEV provider and is recorded as skipped without one.
